topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's focus on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning outcomes regarding mutational progression, stemness, and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications alter transcriptional states to confer selective growth advantages during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cellular Hierarchies and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue hierarchies, stem cell properties, and cell of origin dictate cancer initiation and tumor propagation across different malignancies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Regulation, Profiling Technologies, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how microenvironmental and inflammatory cues promote malignancy, explain the spatial technologies used to profile these cellular interactions, and synthesize the multi-factorial nature of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Session Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the topic for the following lecture.
